# Encoder golden files

`*.parsed.json` and `*.parsed.digest` hold the `ruralz.canonical.v1` bytes and digest that the encoder writes for parsed trees, before stage G materializes defaults and normalizes scalars: `shop` for the base files of the golden corpus's `shop-bundle` entry (`test/conformance/config/golden/shop-bundle/bundle/`, and its JSON twin `bundle-json/`) with `${VAR}` substituted as the render without `--env` does, and `minimal` for `../bundles/minimal` (and its JSON twin). They pin the encoder, an internal form of this package, not the Revision of a Bundle: the golden corpus of pipeline output, the `shop-bundle` Revision included, lives in `test/conformance/config`, and this package keeps no copy of its Bundles or outputs (docs/engineering/03-testing-and-quality-strategy.md, "Golden tests"). Regenerate with `go test -run Golden -update`.
